title: Government Scholarships Programme Paraguay BECAL-DAAD Master
summary: Scholarship for Paraguayan graduates to complete a master's degree in Germany, covering a German course, health insurance, and allowances provided through cooperation with the Paraguayan Ministry of Finance.

degree_levels.notes: Master programme at a German university and, where appropriate, in conjunction with a non-university research Institution.

subject_areas.notes: No specific subjects mentioned on the page.

institutions.notes: German university and, where appropriate, in conjunction with a non-university research Institution.

residence.notes: Country in which you are living and from which you are applying is Paraguay.

mandatory.text: Above-average performances during the previous studies

funding.description: Living expenses with a monthly amount of 1.300,00 EUR paid by the Paraguayan Ministry of Finance.
funding.duration: Maximum duration of twenty-four (24) months (excluding intensive German course up to six months).

application_rounds.notes: No dates specified on the page.

steps.text: Applications need to be submitted exclusively via the online portal of the Paraguayan Ministry of Finance at http://www.becal.gov.py/.

sources.title: Government Scholarships Programme Paraguay BECAL-DAAD Master - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international students from Paraguay physically completing a master's degree in Germany.
